system.boundary: Build a three-dimensional quadruped robot with a finite-mass torso, four articulated two-link legs, eight torque-actuated revolute joints, and four spatial foot-ground contacts.
engineering_objects: F90-XROBO-03 plant and controller described by the current public task contract
Measured output interfaces: body_state, joint_state, contact_state, control_state
physical_paths: Prescribing body motion, replaying stored trajectories, bypassing the articulated contacts, or logging signals disconnected from the simulated plant is not valid.
Normalized actions must causally map through the declared torque limit to the applied hip and knee torques.
functional_paths: Use measured body motion, joint motion, and contact behavior in a causal feedback controller or policy that produces eight bounded actions.
The controller form is not prescribed: learned, model-based, and conventional feedback implementations are all allowed.
information_paths: initial_body_height_m, initial_forward_velocity_mps, initial_vertical_velocity_mps, torso_mass_kg, ground_friction_scale, ground_stiffness_npm, ground_damping_nspm, joint_torque_limit_nm -> F90-XROBO-03 plant/control path -> body_state, joint_state, contact_state, control_state
modes_and_events: The controller form is not prescribed: learned, model-based, and conventional feedback implementations are all allowed.

interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named body_state, joint_state, contact_state, and control_state. body_state has 12 channels in this order: world x, y, z (m); world vx, vy, vz (m/s); roll, pitch, yaw (rad); and world angular velocity x, y, z (rad/s).

interfaces.name: joint_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named body_state, joint_state, contact_state, and control_state. joint_state has 16 channels: FL, FR, RL, RR hip and knee angles (rad), followed by the corresponding eight speeds (rad/s), using hip then knee within each leg.

interfaces.name: contact_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named body_state, joint_state, contact_state, and control_state. contact_state has 8 channels: FL, FR, RL, RR normal force followed by FL, FR, RL, RR friction-force magnitude, all in N.

interfaces.name: control_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named body_state, joint_state, contact_state, and control_state. control_state has 16 channels: the eight normalized hip and knee actions in the same leg order, followed by the eight applied joint torques (N*m).
